## Review Checklist

Before opening this PR, please ensure you have completed the following:

- [ ] I have read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://pillar.markineo.com.br/contributing/guidelines).
- [ ] My code uses American English for all names, comments, and logs.
- [ ] I have avoided mutable static state and preferred constructor injection.
- [ ] I have ensured the changes are small, cohesive, and address a single concern.
- [ ] I have compiled the project successfully (`./gradlew clean build`).
- [ ] If applicable, I have successfully run the integration test suite via Testcontainers (`./gradlew check`).
- [ ] I have updated the public documentation (or verified it does not require an update).
